import pandas as pd

def main():
    # Define source file paths
    source_files = [
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_66/test_0.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_66/test_1.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_66/test_2.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_66/test_3.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_66/test_4.csv"
    ]

    # List to hold dataframes
    dfs = []

    # Load each source CSV into a dataframe
    for file_path in source_files:
        df = pd.read_csv(file_path, dtype=str)  # Read all columns as string to match target schema
        dfs.append(df)

    # Concatenate all source dataframes into one
    combined_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

    # Ensure columns are exactly as target schema and in correct order
    target_columns = ['Year', 'Category', 'Nominee', 'Movie', 'Winner']
    combined_df = combined_df[target_columns]

    # Clean data if necessary:
    # - Strip whitespace from string columns
    for col in target_columns:
        combined_df[col] = combined_df[col].astype(str).str.strip()

    # - Normalize 'Winner' column to uppercase 'YES' or 'NO' (if any other values exist)
    #   Based on examples, 'Winner' is 'YES' for winners, so keep as is.
    #   If there are any other values, convert them to 'NO'.
    combined_df['Winner'] = combined_df['Winner'].apply(lambda x: 'YES' if x.upper() == 'YES' else 'NO')

    # Save the combined dataframe to the target path
    target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_66/target_multisource_cot.csv"
    combined_df.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
